run_experiment: run a multi-day signaling experiment with marketplace trading and dyadic date conversations between agents
get_marketplace_config: create a marketplace simulation config with buyer agents, sellers, and goods for a given number of rounds
get_all_goods_from_spec: convert a nested goods specification dictionary into a flat list of Good objects with prices and inventory
run_experiment_asocial: run a marketplace-only experiment that skips DIAL date conversations and personal events entirely
run_experiment_subculture: run a signaling experiment using subculture goods to test agent behavior with different item categories
